title: Getting Started Practice 3
statement:
Module 1 (Getting Started) covers: what is html, document structure, text elements, links and images, lists and tables, forms, semantic html, media: audio, video, embeds. Solve this practice problem using what you learned.

Exercise 3: write a small program that demonstrates one concept from this module (Text Elements).
hints: Re-read the Text Elements lesson example.
Start by declaring your variables, then add the core logic.
Test with the simplest input first, then edge cases.
solutionExplanation: A correct solution applies the module concepts in a small working program.
